text: City Council, at its meeting on August 10, 2023, adopted Striking Committee Item ST2.1 and, in so doing, rescinded the appointments made in 2023.ST1.1 and appointed the following Member of Council to the CreateTO Board of Directors for a term of office until December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed: Councillor Brad Bradford Mayor Olivia Chow has appointed Councillor Paula Fletcher as the Mayor's designate. In accordance with the Shareholder Directions for Build Toronto and the Toronto Port Lands Company, the members appointed to the CreateTO Board of Directors are also appointed to these Corporation Boards.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the item for information.
